_comment: Hard ceilings in BYTES for the shipped `polis` binary, checked by scripts/check-size.mjs (warn locally, --strict in CI's size.yml). Ratchet DOWN as levers land; every INCREASE is a deliberate, reviewed diff of this file. Baseline measured 2026-09-07 on macOS arm64 with the `dist` profile (thin LTO, 1 CGU, symbols stripped; features `cli` = the HTTP model backends + the MCP transports + the Apple embedder): 14,907,904 B — inside the plan's 12–16 MB no-model band. The ceiling is the band's top. The int8 embedding model, when C2 bundles it (`--features bundled-model`), gets its own row here from C2's measurement (plan: ≈ 20–24 MB). RAISED 2026-09-08 to 17,000,000 at the C2 merge: the `cli` feature now carries the portable embedding providers (model2vec runtime + the pinned download + the remote client), measured 16,351,728 B on macOS arm64 with the `dist` profile — 0.35 MB over the plan's 12–16 MB no-model band, stated as such; ~4 % headroom. The bundled int8 model measured +31,158,208 B on the same build (C2), far above the plan's 20–24 MB band, so `binaryWithBundledModelBytes` stays unset until that path is trimmed and measured again. RAISED 2026-10-07 to 18,500,000 for v0.2.0: main at 4367ef1 (the retrieval, lifecycle and SDK work since C2) already measured 17,750,000 B, over the 17 MB ceiling before this release; v0.2.0 (setup/uninstall, Codex/Cursor capture, reply capture, scrubbing, injection, the skill) measured 18,080,000 B on macOS arm64 with the `dist` profile. ~2 % headroom; trimming candidates are the unused HTTP model backend features in `cli` and the rmcp/axum surface.
